description: X1 29-DoF allmimic training run on Gradmotion (1x4090D 24GB). Read by scripts/gm_x1_train.py; every non-underscore key becomes --<key> for allmimic.train, and an explicit key overrides the same key in --preset recommended. Two deliberate deviations from the preset, both to get a first end-to-end run through on one 24 GB card: compile_bptt/compile_wm off (the preset's torch.compile + CUDA-graph path needs >15 min and >10 GB host RAM to compile before the first iteration) and bptt_checkpoint 1 (policy-update peak 14.5 -> 7.1 GB at pi_batch 4096). Restore the preset flags once the pipeline is known to run.
